displayName: OCI-PCI-005: PCI-DSS — PAN Displayed in Cleartext
description:
Detects primary account numbers displayed in cleartext violating PCI-DSS Requirement 3

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_005", "metricName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'oci_objectstorage' AND "metricName" = 'StorageSizeBytes' AND "value" > 0
